gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Commanding and a little theatrical, Metamorphous sits high on its midline with generous space around every letter. Stint Ultra Expanded, a classic serif, lets each character float apart with open counters, so a long passage reads slowly and deliberately.
gen-gf-miniver-fs-rowan: Bold but surprisingly light on its feet, Miniver keeps its round letters free of pinching and shades its strokes moderately. And Rowan, a serif with generous openings in every curve, is the literary, friendly half that makes the pair worth a second look.
gen-gf-modern-antiqua-fs-rowan: Modern Antiqua has a c and s that look half unwrapped, with mild thicks that keep its expressive streak in check. Rowan, a text serif with thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones, is the friendlier, more bookish voice that sets it off.
gen-gf-mogra-fs-paquito: Neon-tube lettering with a towering x-height. Mogra's rounded-wire strokes and near-closed terminals grab the eye first, then Paquito, a text serif with barely any gap between x-height and caps, sits low and confident underneath to settle things down.
gen-gf-monofett-fs-erode: Monofett's big round lowercase bowls are barely parted, closed up tight with crossbars as thick as the stems. Erode, a serif with a tall middle band and open, broad apertures, gives the page room to breathe, and a modest bump in its size helps.
gen-gf-monofett-fs-paquito: Monofett draws everything as a thread of ink, with big round bowls and joints that never pinch or flare out. Paquito, a text serif, stays low and approachable.
gen-gf-museomoderno-fs-rowan: MuseoModerno is bold and plainly built, with low stroke modulation running all the way through. Rowan, a classic serif with gentle modulation and generous openings in every curve, brings a literary warmth that gives the pair its strongest quality.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-amulya: Amulya reads contemporary and modern, its curves keeping generous gaps that never crowd in on themselves. Mynerve's hand-drawn, pipe-like strokes handle the heading, so a slightly larger body size suits it.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-neco: Friendly and relaxed, Mynerve draws round bowls like cut lengths of cord, with a visible gap at the end of every c. And Neco, a serif with the mild swelling of a worn felt marker, brings dignity, so giving it slightly more size than usual helps.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-recia: Recia, a text serif, reads sharp and authoritative, with a light modulation you notice mainly up close. And Mynerve is the hand-drawn one, holding its stylus at fixed pressure while Recia handles the quieter, more careful work.
